acceptedInterpretation: Implement only G01, the first positive-control group of the 10x15 UDM no-false-DONE baseline. G01 must prove one 15-row ledger can close honestly, but it must not claim G02-G10, the full 10x15 baseline, Authority/fullAuthority, production readiness, or independent two-host completion.
notes: Potential ambiguity in "first group" is resolved as G01 only. This story intentionally stays narrow so it can validate ProofStory gates before later groups are implemented.
